disclosures.exclusionReason: Holding value is not new signed customer equity commitments during the revenue period; customer-only coverage and signing dates are not given.
An outstanding future commitment balance does not establish new commitments signed within the LTM period, counterparty coverage or duplicate/replacement treatment.
A conditional guarantee cap is not equity committed or cash paid; August signing also falls after the July revenue period.
An intention and progressive deployment ceiling do not establish a binding same-period signed equity amount or how subsequent financing replaces this plan.
A real individual investment is useful evidence, but does not prove a complete signed-commitment ledger, original signing date, or duplicate treatment across all customer transactions.
Round participation is original counterparty evidence, but this page does not supply the full executed terms, signing/closing schedule, or reconciliation against the earlier 100B intention.
The NVIDIA ceiling is distinct from Microsoft's 5B and Anthropic's 30B Azure purchase; a ceiling alone does not prove the complete signed amount or closing/cancellation terms.

missingNumeratorEvidence: Complete customer-only set of binding equity commitment records for 2025-07-28 through 2026-07-26, including signed dates and USD amounts.
Original executed/disclosed terms proving customer role, conditions, cancellations, replacements and no double counting across announcements and rounds.
Reviewed coverage reconciliation and a current ledger review under the existing 30-day policy; a fresh retrieval date alone does not prove completeness.
